policies.ranker_only: On a null cell whose attribute has a committed training example, score candidates, collapse value-identical IDs, and write iff the best value class clears the score floor and the margin against the best different value class.
policies.write_gate_then_ranker: Write only if the novelty gate accepts the cell, then apply ranker_only.
policies.write_gate_then_highest_priority_channel: Write only if the gate accepts. Among candidates, pick source support, then verifier hit, then surface over normalized over workload_label, then stable ID.
policies.write_gate_then_source_supported_channel: Write only if the gate accepts and at least one candidate has a source span. Restrict the previous rule to spanned candidates.
policies.committed_pattern_only: A candidate is eligible when its channel, span bit, period bit, and workload-literal bit occurred on a positive training row for that attribute. Write only when eligible candidates share one canonical value.
policies.nearest_positive_pattern_then_ranker: Keep candidates within the training-only median nearest-positive distance for that attribute, then apply the ranker margin rule to that subset.
